questions.stem: What is the term for the ion or molecule that is directly bonded to the central metal atom in a coordination complex?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Ligand'. A ligand is the ion or molecule that is directly bonded to the central metal atom in a coordination complex. The other options are incorrect because 'central atom' refers to the metal itself, 'coordination sphere' refers to the entire complex, and 'counter ion' refers to the ion outside the coordination sphere.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a coordination entity?
questions.solution: The correct answer is [Co(NH3)6]3+ because it is a species formed by the central metal ion bonded to ligands. Chloride ion, ammonia molecule, and silver ion are not coordination entities as they do not contain a central metal ion bound to ligands.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a coordination isomer?
questions.solution: Coordination isomerism occurs when ligands are exchanged between different metal ions in a complex. [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 and [Co(NH3)5Cl]Cl2 show coordination isomerism because the NH3 and Cl ligands are distributed differently. The other options represent geometrical, linkage, and ionisation isomerism, respectively.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक समन्वय आइसोमर का उदाहरण है?
hi.solution: समन्वय आइसोमरिज्म तब होता है जब एक जटिल में विभिन्न धातु आयनों के बीच लिगैंडों का आदान-प्रदान होता है। [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 और [Co(NH3)5Cl]Cl2 समन्वय आइसोमरिज्म दर्शाते हैं क्योंकि NH3 और Cl लिगैंड अलग-अलग तरीके से वितरित होते हैं। अन्य विकल्प क्रमशः भूमितीय, संयोजन और आयनीकरण आइसोमरिज्म का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct formula for the coordination compound: Potassium hexacyanidoferrate(III)?
questions.solution: The correct formula is K3[Fe(CN)6]. The oxidation state of Fe in this compound is +3, and there are three potassium ions to balance the charge of the complex ion [Fe(CN)6]^3-. The other options have incorrect numbers of potassium ions.

questions.stem: What is the name of the ligand that donates two pairs of electrons to the central metal ion?
questions.solution: A didentate ligand donates two pairs of electrons to the central metal ion. Unidentate ligands only donate one pair, ambidentate ligands can donate from two different sites but not necessarily two pairs, and polydentate ligands donate more than two pairs. The definition of a didentate ligand matches the question exactly.

questions.stem: Which of the following coordination complexes is expected to be diamagnetic?
questions.solution: The complex [Co(NH3)6]3+ is expected to be diamagnetic because NH3 is a strong field ligand that causes the 3d electrons of Co to pair up, resulting in no unpaired electrons. [Ni(CN)4]2- is also likely to be diamagnetic, but [Co(NH3)6]3+ is a more classic example. [Fe(H2O)6]2+ and [MnCl4]2- have unpaired electrons and are paramagnetic.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा समन्वय यौगिक अनुचुम्बकीय होने की अपेक्षा रखा जाता है?
hi.solution: समन्वय यौगिक [Co(NH3)6]3+ अनुचुम्बकीय होने की अपेक्षा रखा जाता है क्योंकि NH3 एक मजबूत क्षेत्र लिगैंड है जो Co के 3d इलेक्ट्रॉनों को युग्मित कर देता है, जिसके कारण कोई अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉन नहीं रहता। [Ni(CN)4]2- भी संभवतः अनुचुम्बकीय हो सकता है, लेकिन [Co(NH3)6]3+ एक अधिक पारंपरिक उदाहरण है। [Fe(H2O)6]2+ और [MnCl4]2- में अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं और ये चुम्बकीय होते हैं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct formula for the coordination compound 'dichloridobis(ethane-1,2-diamine)cobalt(III) chloride'?
questions.solution: The correct formula is [CoCl2(en)2]Cl because the name 'dichloridobis(ethane-1,2-diamine)cobalt(III) chloride' indicates that there are two chloride ions outside the complex. 'Cl2' and 'Cl3' would not balance the charge of the complex, and 'Cl4' is incorrect because the name specifies only one chloride counter ion. The oxidation state of cobalt is +3, and the ligands are neutral, so the complex has a +3 charge. One chloride ion is needed to balance it.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा समन्वय यौगिक 'डाइक्लोरिडोबिस(एथेन-1,2-डाइएमीन)कोबाल्ट(III) क्लोराइड' के लिए सही सूत्र है?

questions.stem: Which of the following coordination complexes is optically active?
questions.solution: Optical activity is shown by complexes that are chiral, meaning they have non-superimposable mirror images. [CoCl2(en)2] is optically active because it has a non-superimposable mirror image. The other complexes either lack chirality or are not chiral due to symmetry. [PtCl2(NH3)2] is not chiral, [NiCl2(NH3)2] is not chiral, and [Co(NH3)6]3+ is symmetrical.

questions.stem: In the ruby gemstone, what role do chromium(III) ions play?
choices: They are part of the lattice structure
They form a complex with oxygen
They cause the colour by d–d transitions
questions.solution: Chromium(III) ions in ruby cause the gemstone's red color through d–d electron transitions in the crystal field. They do not form a complex with oxygen, as their role is primarily electronic rather than structural.

questions.stem: Which of the following has the highest magnetic moment value?

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about hybridisation in coordination compounds is correct?

questions.stem: Why does [Ni(CN)4]2- have a different colour in solution compared to [Ni(H2O)6]2+?
choices: Due to different oxidation states of Ni
Due to different ligands causing different d-orbital splitting
Due to different numbers of coordination sites
questions.solution: The difference in colour is due to the different ligands causing different d-orbital splitting. CN- is a strong field ligand, leading to a larger splitting and different absorption of light compared to H2O, which is a weak field ligand. The oxidation state and number of coordination sites are the same for both complexes.
